$comment: BC's Ministry of Transportation and Transit: the operator of the province's inland ferries (config/feeds/bc-inland-ferries/), run under contract (Western Pacific Marine answers for the Kootenay Lake ferry, per its page). These are the Kootenay Lake ferry's MV Osprey 2000, which runs every winter sailing.
name: BC Inland Ferries

ferry.$maxSpeed: km/h. 8.97 km Balfour to Kootenay Bay (the OSM way's length) in 35 minutes, berth to berth: about 15 km/h on average, so cruising near 18 (guess; config/regions/kootenays/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #5).
ferry.$length: m. The Osprey 2000 carries 80 vehicles (BC government page, checked 2026-10-28); about 75 m long and 18 m wide (guess, from imagery; config/regions/kootenays/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #5).
